intro: Kesem Records is the music production studio and selected catalogue of Avichai Tuchman (DoGBeaT). DoGBeaT is the artist, composer and producer identity; Kesem Records houses studio work and the catalogue.

bio.title: Avichai Tuchman / DoGBeaT
paragraphs: I'm Avichai Tuchman — also credited as Avi Tuchman, Avichay Tuchman, אביחי טוכמן or אבי טוכמן — known artistically as DoGBeaT. Based in Tel Aviv, I work as a music producer, composer, bassist and mixing engineer. My sound connects live instruments, rhythmic grooves and electronic textures.

Selected work and collaborations include Noam Rotem, Reines Girls, Roei Freilich, Balkan Beat Box and Shuli Rand; roles vary by recording. My collaboration with Noa Faran includes the six-track EP 'מקרה אבוד' (2026). See verified, role-specific credits for the precise contribution.
I also work on music for screen and theater, including projects alongside Assaf Talmudi. Explore music for film, TV and advertising. Rights and licensing routes depend on the recording and version.
For original composition, artist production and mixing, start with the DoGBeaT project brief.

whatWeDo.title: What We Do
whatWeDo.text: Music production, composition, arrangements, sound design and mixing for artists and screen projects. Selected DoGBeaT recordings can be licensed via their specific Artlist pages; other uses require rights-holder confirmation. Credits and available rights vary by recording.

approach.title: Approach
approach.text: We believe in precision without sterility. Each sound is intentional, each silence meaningful. Our process combines analog warmth with digital precision, vintage character with modern clarity.
